title: John Reynolds trails tomorrow's Bloomberg TV episode on the AI question — Eric calls the rush to replace human creativity with AI an 'industrial-scale scandal'
summary: The day before the Extraordinary Life Stories episode airs, host John Reynolds pulls out the sharpest thread from the conversation: whether we are delegating the act of learning itself to AI. His summary of Eric's position is to use AI to augment human creativity rather than replace it — don't just ask AI to do the task, ask it to teach you how.
blockquote:
Eric Ries describes the rush to replace human creativity with AI as an “industrial-scale scandal.”

His argument is that we should be using AI to augment human creativity, not replace it.

Don’t just ask AI to do the task.

Ask it to teach you how to do the task.

That distinction feels increasingly important.
